void kernel_bicg(double A[42][38], double s[38], double q[42], double p[38], double r[42]) {
    // Compute q = A * p (matrix-vector multiplication)
    for (int i = 0; i < 42; i++) {
        q[i] = 0.0;
        for (int j = 0; j < 38; j++) {
            q[i] += A[i][j] * p[j];
        }
    }

    // Compute s = A^T * r (transpose matrix-vector multiplication)
    for (int j = 0; j < 38; j++) {
        s[j] = 0.0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 42; i++) {
            s[j] += A[i][j] * r[i];
        }
    }
}
